usage_no_snapshot: No snapshot yet — the poller refreshes every 5 minutes after you sign in.
settings_model_section_desc: shim overrides whatever Cursor sends with these values. Type `codex` as the model name in Cursor and your choice here wins.
settings_account_desc: ChatGPT OAuth session used by the proxy.
setup_subtitle: Reference for plugging Cursor (or any OpenAI-compatible client) into this proxy.
setup_no_tunnel_desc: Cursor BYOK refuses private networks. Start onboarding to register your public domain.
setup_public_url_desc: Cursor BYOK refuses private networks (localhost, 127.0.0.1), so this proxy must sit behind a public domain. Cloudflare Tunnel is the easiest path.
setup_zero_trust_note: In Cloudflare Zero Trust, restrict the tunnel route to ^/v1/.* — the dashboard stays local-only.
byok_step3_tail: as the API key — shim uses your ChatGPT session, not the key.
byok_model_hint: shim swaps this for your chosen Codex model
welcome_subtitle: A local proxy that exposes your ChatGPT Plus / Pro subscription to Cursor through the Codex OAuth flow. Let's get you set up.
welcome_signin_desc: We'll open a tab to ChatGPT for the Codex OAuth handshake. Your tokens stay on this machine — they never leave your local Convex instance.
welcome_fallback_summary: Port 1455 is busy — paste the redirect URL
welcome_fallback_desc: If the Codex CLI is already running locally, port 1455 won't be free for our listener. After consenting, copy the redirect URL from your browser's address bar and paste it here.
model_subtitle: shim overrides whatever Cursor sends with the model you choose here. You can change it any time from Settings.
tunnel_subtitle: Cursor BYOK refuses private networks (localhost, 127.0.0.1) — you need a public URL fronting this proxy. Cloudflare Tunnel takes a minute and is free.
tunnel_step1_note: In the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard, restrict the tunnel route to ^/v1/.* so only the proxy is reachable; the dashboard stays local.
tunnel_step2_desc: The origin Cursor will hit, e.g. https://shim.yourdomain.com. We save the origin only — the /v1 suffix gets added where it's needed.
tunnel_locked: Locked by the CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_URL env var.
cursor_subtitle: Point Cursor at the public URL you just set. shim will accept whatever model name Cursor sends and swap it for the one you picked.
cursor_no_tunnel_desc: Go back one step and save your public URL — Cursor refuses localhost.
test_subtitle: We'll send a tiny request through the proxy and confirm Codex answers. This is the same path Cursor will use.
test_synthetic_desc: Server-side round-trip to Codex using the model you picked above.
test_ready: You're ready to use shim from Cursor.
notfound_desc: the page you're looking for does not exist.
toast_authorize_listener_unavailable: listener unavailable — paste the redirect URL below after consent.
